note: Ordinance amending the 2016 Communication Code (digital media professionals, sanctions); it is a media law, not an access to information law, and creates no right-to-records procedure or oversight body for access requests.

facts.fact: UNESCO's contribution to the 42nd Universal Periodic Review states that Gabon has no access to information law and encourages it to adopt one; no draft is named. The document gives no event date, so its published date is used.

systems.system: Code de la Communication (loi n°019/2016 du 9 août 2016)

facts.fact: Journalist Herton-Sena Omoungou writes in a Convergence Afrique op-ed that no law sets out access to administrative documents in Gabon, and a bill announced in 2023 remains a rough draft not yet submitted to Parliament.
